name: Vice Chancellor's Academic Achievement Scholarship
summary: Cash scholarship for high-achieving school leavers starting their first Griffith undergraduate degree.
key: Cash (from $15,000) + Student Academy of Excellence offer + access to a travel grant.
who: Be a commencing undergraduate student in Trimester 1, 2027.
Receive an unadjusted ATAR of 95.45 or above.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
Include your QTAC or UAC reference number.
catches: Apply by Monday 21 December 2026, 4pm for Trimester 1, 2027, Round 1.
